design.purpose: Make a six-pointed paper snowflake for a window or card, for one person, using the photographed scissors and one square sheet of paper.

steps.c: Place the 21 cm square paper flat
Fold top-right corner onto bottom-left corner
Fold top-left corner onto bottom-right corner
Fold top-right edge through top at 30°
Fold top-left edge through top at 30°
Cut straight across the wide end
Cut a notch from one folded side
Cut a notch from the other folded side
Cut a small V at the pointed tip
Open the sheet out flat again
